title: 有馬記念の後に・友を繋ぎし誠は信

text_block_list.name: Caster
text_block_list.text: Yaeno Muteki?! It's Yaeno Muteki! Yaeno Muteki has won the Arima Kinen!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Wooooo!

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: I defeated Oguri and Tamamo!

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: (I've mastered both blaze fierce and water still and won! If I can keep this up, then…)

text_block_list.name: Interviewer
text_block_list.text: Congratulations on your victory, Yaeno Muteki! Can you tell us how you're feeling right now?

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: Th-thank you very much! All of my hard work and training has paid off!

text_block_list.name: Interviewer
text_block_list.text: You and Oguri Cap started at the same time. Would it be safe to say you've been keeping an eye on her?

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: …That's right. She's such an incredible racer, it would be impossible not to be aware of her.

text_block_list.name: Interviewer
text_block_list.text: I see. We're looking forward to seeing the two of you race again! Thank you for the interview!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Wooooo!

text_block_list.name: Fan B
text_block_list.text: Oguriiii! You were so great! You were practically glowing! Good luck next time too!

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text: Thanks for your support, everyone.

text_block_list.name: Fan B
text_block_list.text: No, thank you, Oguri!

text_block_list.name: Interviewer
text_block_list.text: Oguri Cap, could we have a word? How did you feel facing off against Tamamo Cross?

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text: Losing to her at the autumn Tenno Sho was rough, so I really wanted to win today.

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text: But Yaeno was… quite the force.

text_block_list.name: Spectator D
text_block_list.text: So are you, Oguri Cap! You'll get 'em next time!

text_block_list.name: Fan A
text_block_list.text: You're the leader of your whole generation, Oguri! We're counting on you!

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: …Huh?

text_block_list.name: Interviewer
text_block_list.text: That was Oguri Cap, who many are hailing as the star of the classic racers! We're all looking forward to watching her next year too!

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: The star of the classic racers…

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: (There's no questioning Oguri's prowess.)

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: (But I'm the one who won today!)

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: (And I'm the one who battled for the Classic Triple Crown…)

text_block_list.name: Fan A
text_block_list.text: Oguri Cap is on par with Tamamo Cross in both skill and popularity. Next year's Twinkle Series is shaping up to be one to remember!

text_block_list.name: Fan C
text_block_list.text: Yaeno Muteki mighta won, but didja see how well Oguri did?! I mean, whaddya expect from someone who's been goin' head-to-head with Tamamo!

text_block_list.name: Fan B
text_block_list.text: Well, if we're talking about this year's classic racers, I've got my eye on Super Creek!

text_block_list.name: Spectator D
text_block_list.text: No way! Oguri's on a whole 'nother level! I can't wait to see how many G1s she wins!

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: (Why?!)

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: (I won! I beat Oguri and Tamamo both! I'm standing here right in front of you!)

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: (Why are you all talking about Oguri?! I should be the star of this generation! Me!

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: (Why isn't anyone talking about our fierce battle at the Japanese Derby?!)

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text: I won't let you beat me! The Derby is mine!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text: No way! I won't give up! I'm winning this for Maruzen!

text_block_list.name: Ardan & Chiyono O
text_block_list.text: Aaaaahhh! Raaaaagh!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text: I don't care if my legs shatter! I will burn out my very lifeforce! And that light will serve as proof that I was alive!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text: No, no, no, no, nooo! The Derby's mine! It's miiiiine!

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: Yaaaaah!

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: (Chiyono O ran like her life depended on it!)

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: (Ardan put everything on the line!)

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: (And I tore up the track right beside them!)

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: (It's burned into my heart, setting it atremble to this very day!)

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text: … It's not like anyone's waiting for me, anyway.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text: But how many people are really going to remember my name when I'm not racing?

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text: The longer I'm off the track, the more distant a memory I become.

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: (Why should Chiyono O and Mejiro Ardan have to fear that they won't have a place to return to?!)

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: I faced them in the Classic Triple Crown! I won the Arima Kinen! And I'm still here!

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: Witness me!

text_block_list.name: Spectator E
text_block_list.text: Eeeeek! Oguri! Look over here!

text_block_list.name: Spectator D
text_block_list.text: Oguri Cap! Good luck next year!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Wooo! Wooooo!

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: So that's how it's going to be?! In that case…

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: RAAAAAHHHHH!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: In the center of the turf, Yaeno Muteki throws back her head and lets out a roar filled with enough rage to pierce the sky.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: But that angry cry is swallowed up in the thunderous roar of cheers for the other two racers. No one in the crowd hears her.

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: Listen up, Trainer!

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: My next goal is to defeat Oguri!

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: Everyone is saying that she's the best!

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: So it stands to reason that defeating her will serve as proof of my power!

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: No one will be able to ignore the person who brings down Oguri!

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: Everyone will have to remember that Chiyono O, Ardan and I are the ones who raced in the Classic Triple Crown! We are the who will carry this generation forward!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Yaeno Muteki says all of this in one rushed breath, rage steaming off of her as if she was truly burning.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: She's beginning to lose herself in her fury. However, the feeling driving that rage is…

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: An insane and forceful drive to defeat Oguri Cap. In other words—an obsession.

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: Well, Trainer?! I'd like to hear what you're thinking!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: I doubt that Yaeno Muteki wants a drawn-out discussion right now, so I skip straight to the point.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Now that she's found her obsession, I'll gladly push her towards it.

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: Music to my ears! I couldn't have said it better myself!
